communicai_bullets: Designed role-based access-control rules that block insecure direct object references (IDOR), privilege escalation, and message spoofing; validated with 36 adversarial unit tests.

Built server-authoritative Cloud Functions enforcing authentication, input validation, and per-user and global rate limiting (5 rewrites per user/day); added server-side Apple receipt verification to prevent subscription fraud.
Implemented privacy controls including full account and data deletion and scheduled data-retention cleanup, and kept all credentials and secrets out of version control.
